purpose: software regression fixtures for rnpbench evaluate; not a scientific selection; no fixture value is reported as a benchmark result
pool: released score_v3 stores; scored categories use Boltz-2 exec_A designated outputs (model_0, the engine's rank-0) on the five-engine common population (59 targets), so both the released DockQ row and the frozen four-axis geometry row exist; the no-value category uses the released RF3 rows (the only engine with refusals other than AF3)

categories_in_assignment_order.no_value: status NO_VALUE in the released store; first by (target, execution, model_idx)
categories_in_assignment_order.equivalent_copies: n_admissible_candidates >= 2 and the reference holds >= 2 chains of the protein entity
categories_in_assignment_order.residue_numbering: a native chain of the selected mapping has auth_seq_id != label_seq_id (construct position) for at least one residue, or insertion codes
categories_in_assignment_order.partial_reference: a native chain of the selected mapping has fewer than 60% of its construct positions observed
categories_in_assignment_order.short_rna: RNA construct <= 5 nt, one protein and one RNA chain in the reference, a single admissible candidate
categories_in_assignment_order.ordinary: one protein and one RNA chain in the reference; single admissible candidate; RNA 20-60 nt; >= 90% of construct positions observed in both chains; auth == label numbering; all paired residues in frame

selection_within_category: smallest protein + RNA construct length, ties by target identifier; a target already assigned to an earlier category is skipped
constructed_negative_controls: two inputs derived from the ordinary fixture, labelled as constructed: (i) the RNA chain removed from the prediction; (ii) the prediction's residue numbering shifted by +1000. Their expected outputs are whatever the frozen code returns; the test asserts only that each is a no-value state and never DockQ = 0
